# Edriva Global

> Edriva Global is an international education consultancy helping students research and prepare for study opportunities abroad through personalised, transparent guidance.

Official website: https://edrivaglobal.com
Primary language: English
Contact: info@edrivaglobal.com

## Core Services

- [University Selection](https://edrivaglobal.com/services/university-selection): Personalised university and program shortlisting.
- [Application Support](https://edrivaglobal.com/services/application-support): Guidance with application documents, timelines and submissions.
- [Scholarship Guidance](https://edrivaglobal.com/services/scholarships): Help finding and preparing for relevant funding opportunities.
- [Visa Assistance](https://edrivaglobal.com/services/visa-assistance): Student visa documentation and application-readiness support.
- [SOP and CV Support](https://edrivaglobal.com/services/sop-cv): Guidance for clear, authentic application documents.
- [Pre-Departure Support](https://edrivaglobal.com/services/pre-departure): Practical preparation for travel and arrival.

## Important Accuracy Notes

- Edriva Global does not guarantee admission, scholarships or visas.
- Admissions, tuition, scholarship and visa requirements can change.
- Applicants should verify current requirements through official university and government sources.
- Universities displayed for exploration do not imply official partnerships unless explicitly stated.
- Testimonials labelled as demo content are placeholders and must not be treated as verified student claims.
